description.value: Bamboo Palace Restaurant is a long-standing Cantonese-style Chinese restaurant on South Fraser Way in Abbotsford, offering an extensive menu of chop suey, chow mein, beef, seafood, and vegetarian dishes. The restaurant operates as a full dine-in establishment and also offers pick-up and free home delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists coming off a long road day. A wide-ranging menu and accessible strip-mall location make it a practical refuelling option for touring riders in the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 33508 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2S 2B5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant is real and open ('WE ARE OPEN!') for dine-in, pick-up, and delivery at 33508 South Fraser Way, which the hours page labels as Abbotsford, BC — contradicting the OSM community field of 'Chilliwack'; V2S 2B5 is an Abbotsford postal code, so the OSM community tag is wrong. Phone and address match between OSM and website. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere; the menu includes an explicit 'Vegetarian' section with multiple dishes, and pick-up is clearly confirmed.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the business is in Abbotsford, BC (confirmed by website hours page and postal code V2S 2B5).
OSM opening_hours differ from website hours page: OSM shows Sunday 11:00-14:00 lunch service and Tuesday open, but website lists Sunday from 4pm only and Tuesday as closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by active website and consistent contact details; suitable stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal in Abbotsford.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian' section with at least nine distinct dishes including bean curd, mushroom, and mixed vegetable options
